**cs-benchmark** is a project in [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md). Its code is written mainly in [C#](@/glossary/csharp.md) (100 %).

The [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) was created on 6 January 2014; its latest [commit](@/glossary/commit.md) is from 7 January 2014. It reads “Rounds”. With no commit in the last 48 months it is listed as archive: work from 2014, kept for the record and dated as measured.

Its source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/korczis/cs-benchmark) and [GitLab](https://gitlab.com/korczis/cs-benchmark).

Related work in [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md): [Rocnikac4](@/work/rocnikac4.md) (2013), [generator-the-scratch](@/work/generator-the-scratch.md) (2013), [skull-erlang](@/work/skull-erlang.md) (2014) and [skull-haskell](@/work/skull-haskell.md) (2014).
